Emmy-nominated VFX Supervisor Marion Spates, known for his work on Stranger Things, WandaVision, Lost in Space, and the newest TV show Avatar: The Last Airbender, explains how they manage to achieve some of their high-quality VFX results in Avatar: The Last Airbender.

Did you even notice when Aang was full CG vs real?
